    Personal Project

    Custom Fitness Tracking

    Apple's Health and Activity apps don't show the stats I am curious about, so I built my own. I exported 5.6 million lines of raw XML Health data, parsed it into Parquet, and charted pace on repeat routes, pace by heart-rate zone, workout type distribution with custom categories, and gym PRs.
